target.statement: SimpleCount effective test ROC-AUC = 0.664 on Bitcoin-Alpha (one-feature baseline, no parameter fitting)

compute.basis: SimpleCount is a single O(|E|) chronological pass over 24K edges plus a train-slice AUC feature selection and test AUC; the only real work is fetching Bitcoin-Alpha and reimplementing the 14-feature extractor from Algorithm 1 if the repo is incomplete.

blockers: Repo may not include the exact SimpleCount feature-extraction script or the Bitcoin-Alpha preprocessing/split, requiring reimplementation from Algorithm 1
Bitcoin-Alpha must be obtained from the original signed-network source (not bundled by the paper)
Exact reproduction of 0.664 depends on matching the 85/15 chronological split and B=1000 bucketing conventions
title: Beat the Counter First: A Baseline for Temporal-Graph Anomaly Detectors
